Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was riding in the front passenger seat of our sedan when the collision happened in the parking lot on 9-17-23 in
Katy. My husband was driving slowly down the center aisle, looking for an open space, when a pickup backed out
from a row to our left without stopping. Its rear bumper struck the driver's side of our car hard enough to spin us
partway around. The airbags deployed, and the impact threw my head forward and then back against the headrest.
Two children were in the back seat, and both of them cried out and complained of pain in their necks and shoulders.
My husband held his chest where the seatbelt pressed against him and said his wrist hurt. I felt dizzy and had a
stinging pain in my neck for the rest of the afternoon. We all sat in the car until help arrived, and everyone was taken
to be checked by medical staff.
